And where the token identifies a user, one entry with reason "NO_ROLE" and decision code "AC-DENY" is written

  Scenario: AC9 A caller holding no Workbench role is refused with 401 and recorded (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the token of the caller resolves to a user who holds no Workbench role
    When the caller calls GET /api/recovery/access/v1/me/session
    Then the call is refused with status 401 and MSG-P4-001 and no operation runs
    And one entry with reason "NO_ROLE" and decision code "AC-DENY" is written

  Scenario: AC10 No role holds both the loader right and the approver right of the rule package (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given matrix version "PM-2026.11" is in force with RW-COE Rules and parameters "C" and RW-RISK Rules and parameters "A"
    When RW-SECADM reads GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/roles
    Then no role is returned with both "C" and "A" in the area "RULES_AND_PARAMETERS"
    And the answer holds RW-COE with "C" and RW-RISK with "A"
